messages:
From: Daniel Price <daniel.price@acme-corp.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Platform outage 2026-06-01 - observed downtime & latency spikes

Hi Karthik,

We experienced what looks like an outage (or very high latency) on Redwood between 08:57 and 09:16 PDT today. Several of our customer-facing flows saw failed token calls and timeouts; our monitoring shows error rates spiking to ~23% and median latency jumping from ~120ms to 2.4s.

Can you confirm whether this maps to an incident on your side and whether that window will count toward SLA downtime? We need confirmation to start our internal incident review and to calculate any eligible service credits under the contract.

I've attached our request log (acme_incident_log_0601.csv) with the timing and example request IDs. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Price
Platform Reliability Lead, Acme Corporation

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-03T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: ACME downtime eligibility calc and postmortem request

Team — I pulled the customer's logs and sketched a quick downtime calc (attached: sla_downtime_calc_0603.xlsx). Preliminary notes:
- Customer-reported window ~19 minutes (08:57–09:16 PDT).
- Cross-referenced router and host metrics: we have an internal incident event at 08:58–09:14 with elevated queueing on shard cluster-7.
- Our standard SLA: 99.9% monthly uptime. For a 30-day month that equates to ~43.2 minutes of allowed downtime. Since the measured outage is 16 minutes of confirmed platform unavailability (we exclude client-side timeouts and the first 1 minute of packet loss per policy), they exceed no monthly threshold but are eligible for a pro-rated credit per the credit table because the outage degraded sustained availability for a contiguous window.

Questions for SRE (Jonas):
1) Confirm host-level confirmation and whether any maintenance/auto-scaling event overlapped.
2) Can we produce an exportable evidence bundle (host logs + router traces) for Acme?

Proposed customer-facing response: acknowledge the confirmed incident, provide the evidence bundle, confirm eligibility for a 10% service credit for the billing month (per contract fallback), and commit to a postmortem within 7 business days.

I'm happy to draft the customer note once Jonas confirms the technical facts.

-Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: sla_downtime_calc_0603.xlsx
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Daniel Price <daniel.price@acme-corp.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-04T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Platform outage 2026-06-01 - incident confirmation and next steps

Hi Daniel — thank you for the patience while we confirmed the details. Below is our formal position and next steps.

Summary of findings
- Confirmed platform incident window (internal): 2026-06-01T08:58:00–2026-06-01T09:14:00 PDT. Customer-observed error window aligns with our internal telemetry.
- Impact: elevated error rates and increased median latency affecting request throughput; a contiguous ~16-minute window of degraded availability attributable to Redwood infrastructure.

Credit eligibility
- Per the SLA addendum (Section 4.2) and our internal credit rules, Acme is eligible for a pro-rated service credit. Based on the downtime calculation (attached), the preliminary credit amount is 10% of the affected month's Redwood service charges. We will finalize the credit after finance validates billable units and runs the credit calculation.

Deliverables and timeline
- Evidence bundle (host + router logs, request-id crosswalk): attached as acme_incident_log_0601.csv and latency_snapshot_0601.pdf.
- Postmortem: we will deliver a written postmortem with root cause analysis and mitigation plan by 2026-06-11 COB.
- Finance action: Marissa will follow up with Acme's billing contact to apply the credit once the calculation is finalized.

If you'd like a synchronous walkthrough of the evidence bundle or the postmortem when ready, we can schedule that this week.

Apologies again for the disruption — we appreciate the flag and your cooperation as we close this out.

Best regards,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
